what: A staggered dot grid becomes the page-transition cover. When you click a same-site link, background-colored dots swell from the bottom row up (spreading within a .3s per-row delay) to 5.1x over .75s. .1s later a background-colored sheet covers the whole screen in .2s (the page behind is dimmed to 10% ink over .5s) and the page switches at .75s. On the incoming page, dots covering it at 4.8x shrink and lift from the bottom row (spreading within .5s) over 1.25s and the dimming clears over .75s. This is the transition of a company site with a fermentation-bubble dot pattern

options.cell: Cell size (px), default 37 — dots are 40% of a cell, each row is offset by half a cell, and one cell is left empty between dots (Brand 1440 width 37 · phone 375 width 19.2)
options.hold: Time from press to transition (s), default .75 — shorten it for screens flipped often, like apps
options.spread-in: Delay gap between the bottom row and top row when retracting (s), default .5
options.--fx-fill: Dot color (CSS on the consumer side), default var(--kf-bg)
options.--fx-shade: 10% dim color laid down while covering, default var(--kf-ink)
options.fx:done: Event the element emits once fully cleared on the entered page

from.where: shared.js and shared.css .tn-mask (original main.js transitionmask: per-row delay .5−.5·row/row count (.3 when leaving), dot ::before 1.48rem diameter · scale 5.1 covers in .75s · from 4.8 to 0 in 1.25s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), html.transit body:before white curtain opacity .2s linear .1s, dark curtain opacity .1 .5s linear, navigates 750ms after the press). The first-visit loader (dot and logo spreading from the center) lives only on the site

note: Same-address # links, new-window links and download links are left alone. When returning via back (bfcache), the curtain hides immediately
